                                                                .filter(item -> item.getString(Metric.METRIC_PLUGIN).equalsIgnoreCase(NMSConstants.MetricPlugin.SNMP_INTERFACE.getName())).map(JsonObject::copy)
                                                                .findFirst().orElse(null);

                                                        Assertions.assertNotNull(metric);

                                                        Assertions.assertTrue(metric.containsKey(Metric.METRIC_CONTEXT));

                                                        var discoveredObjects = metric.getJsonObject(Metric.METRIC_CONTEXT).getJsonArray(NMSConstants.DISCOVERED_OBJECTS);

                                                        var promise = Promise.<JsonArray>promise();

                                                        var probes = new JsonArray();

                                                        if (discoveredObjects == null || discoveredObjects.isEmpty())
                                                        {
                                                            var discoveries = DiscoveryConfigStore.getStore().getItemsByValue(Discovery.DISCOVERY_TARGET, "172.16.8.2");

                                                            Assertions.assertFalse(discoveries.isEmpty());

                                                            var futures = new ArrayList<Future<Void>>();

                                                            for (var index = 0; index < discoveries.size(); index++)
                                                            {
                                                                var future = Promise.<Void>promise();

                                                                futures.add(future.future());

                                                                Bootstrap.configDBService().getAll(DBConstants.TBL_DISCOVERY_RESULT + discoveries.getJsonObject(index).getLong(ID),
                                                                        result ->
                                                                        {
                                                                            if (result.succeeded() && !result.result().isEmpty())
                                                                            {
                                                                                probes.addAll(result.result());
                                                                            }

                                                                            future.complete();
                                                                        });
                                                            }

                                                            Future.join(futures).onComplete(result ->
                                                            {
                                                                if (!probes.isEmpty())
                                                                {
                                                                    var probe = probes.getJsonObject(0);

                                                                    var probeObjects = probe.getJsonArray(OBJECTS);

                                                                    Assertions.assertFalse(probeObjects.isEmpty());

                                                                    promise.fail(new Exception("failed to find discovery result"));
                                                                }
                                                            });
                                                        }
                                                        else

                                                                        DEFAULT_USER, SYSTEM_REMOTE_ADDRESS,
                                                                        asyncResponse ->
                                                                        {
                                                                            if (asyncResponse.failed())
                                                                            {
                                                                                testContext.failNow(asyncResponse.cause());
                                                                            }
                                                                            else
                                                                            {
                                                                                MetricConfigStore.getStore().updateItem(metric.getLong(ID)).onComplete(asyncResult ->
                                                                                {
                                                                                    if (asyncResult.failed())
                                                                                    {
                                                                                        testContext.failNow(asyncResult.cause());
                                                                                    }
                                                                                    else
                                                                                    {
                                                                                        var item = SchedulerConfigStore.getStore().getItem(response.bodyAsJsonObject().getJsonArray(ID).getLong(0));

                                                                                        Assertions.assertNotNull(item);

                                                                                        assertTestResult(testContext);

                                                                                        Bootstrap.vertx().eventBus().send(UI_ACTION_SCHEDULER_RUN, item.put(USER_NAME, DEFAULT_USER).put(SESSION_ID, TestUtil.getSessionId()));
                                                                                    }
                                                                                });
                                                                            }
                                                                        });
                                                            }
                                                            else

    private void assertTestResult(VertxTestContext testContext)
    {
        consumer = TestUtil.vertx().eventBus().localConsumer(EVENT_USER + TestUtil.getSessionId(), message ->
        {
            try
            {
                if (message.body().getBinary(EVENT_CONTEXT) != null && message.body().containsKey(EVENT_COMPRESSION_TYPE) && message.body().getInteger(EVENT_COMPRESSION_TYPE) == COMPRESSION_TYPE_ONE)
                {
                    var eventContext = CodecUtil.toJSONObject(message.body().getBinary(EventBusConstants.EVENT_CONTEXT));

                    if (eventContext.getString(EVENT_TYPE) != null && eventContext.getString(EVENT_TYPE).contains(": Topology") && eventContext.containsKey(STATUS)
                            && eventContext.getString(AIOpsObject.OBJECT_IP).equalsIgnoreCase("172.16.8.2")
                            && eventContext.getJsonObject(EVENT_CONTEXT) != null && eventContext.getJsonObject(EVENT_CONTEXT).containsKey(OBJECT)
                            && eventContext.getJsonObject(EVENT_CONTEXT).containsKey(TOPOLOGY_PLUGIN_TYPE) && !eventContext.getJsonObject(EVENT_CONTEXT).getString(TOPOLOGY_PLUGIN_TYPE).equalsIgnoreCase("Custom")
                            && (eventContext.getJsonObject(EVENT_CONTEXT).getString(OBJECT).equalsIgnoreCase(NMSConstants.TopologyProtocol.CDP.getName())
                            || eventContext.getJsonObject(EVENT_CONTEXT).getString(OBJECT).equalsIgnoreCase(NMSConstants.TopologyProtocol.LLDP.getName())))
                    {
                        testContext.verify(() ->
                        {
                            Assertions.assertTrue(eventContext.getJsonObject(EVENT_CONTEXT).containsKey(OBJECT));

                            Assertions.assertTrue(eventContext.containsKey(STATUS));

                            Assertions.assertEquals(STATUS_SUCCEED, eventContext.getString(STATUS));

                            consumer.unregister(handler -> testContext.completeNow());
                        });
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception exception)
            {
                testContext.failNow(exception);
            }
        });
    }

    private static void assertTopologyPluginTestResult()
    {
        try
        {
            messageConsumer = TestUtil.vertx().eventBus().localConsumer(EVENT_USER + TestUtil.getSessionId(), message ->
            {
                try
                {
                    if (message.body().containsKey(EVENT_COMPRESSION_TYPE) && message.body().getInteger(EVENT_COMPRESSION_TYPE) == COMPRESSION_TYPE_ONE && message.body().containsKey(EVENT_CONTEXT) && message.body().getBinary(EVENT_CONTEXT) != null)
                    {
                        var eventContext = CodecUtil.toJSONObject(message.body().getBinary(EVENT_CONTEXT));

                        if (eventContext.getString(EVENT_TYPE) != null && eventContext.getString(EVENT_TYPE).contains("Topology Plugin Test") && eventContext.containsKey(STATUS) && eventContext.containsKey(EVENT_CONTEXT) && eventContext.getJsonObject(EVENT_CONTEXT).containsKey("testcase.name"))
                        {
                            var name = eventContext.getJsonObject(EVENT_CONTEXT).getString("testcase.name");

                            var downObject = name.toLowerCase().contains("down");

                            var testContext = CONTEXTS.remove(name);

                            testContext.verify(()->
                            {
                                if (eventContext.getString(MESSAGE) != null)
                                {
                                    assertEquals(downObject ? String.format(ErrorMessageConstants.TOPOLOGY_PLUGIN_TEST_FAILED, ErrorMessageConstants.OBJECT_ERROR) :  InfoMessageConstants.TOPOLOGY_PLUGIN_TEST_SUCCEEDED, eventContext.getString(MESSAGE));
                                }

                                assertEquals(downObject ? STATUS_FAIL : STATUS_SUCCEED, eventContext.getString(STATUS));

                                assertEquals(downObject ? ErrorCodes.ERROR_CODE_NO_ITEM_FOUND : ErrorCodes.ERROR_CODE_SUCCESS, eventContext.getString(ERROR_CODE));

                                testContext.completeNow();
                            });
                        }
                    }
                }
                catch (Exception exception)
                {
                    LOGGER.error(exception);
                }
            });
        }
        catch (Exception exception)
        {
            LOGGER.error(exception);
        }
    }

    private void prepareTestContext(JsonObject context)
    {
        var key = context.getString(TopologyPlugin.TOPOLOGY_PLUGIN_TYPE).equalsIgnoreCase(NMSConstants.TopologyPluginType.CUSTOM.getName()) ? PluginEngineConstants.SCRIPT : PluginEngineConstants.PARSING_SCRIPT;

        var item = context.getJsonObject(TopologyPlugin.TOPOLOGY_PLUGIN_CONTEXT);

        if (item != null && item.getString(key) != null && !item.getString(key).isEmpty())
        {
            var file = GlobalConstants.CURRENT_DIR + GlobalConstants.PATH_SEPARATOR + GlobalConstants.PLUGIN_SCRIPT_DIR + GlobalConstants.PATH_SEPARATOR + TOPOLOGY_DIR + GlobalConstants.PATH_SEPARATOR +
                    item.getString(key);

            if (Bootstrap.vertx().fileSystem().existsBlocking(file))
            {
                item.put(key, CommonUtil.getString(Bootstrap.vertx().fileSystem().readFileBlocking(file)).trim());

                item.put(TIMEOUT, 120);
            }
        }

    }

                        .put(TopologyPlugin.TOPOLOGY_PLUGIN_ENTRY_POINTS, objects).put(OBJECTS, objects)
                        .put(NMSConstants.TOPOLOGY_LINK_LAYER, new JsonArray().add(NMSConstants.TopologyLinkLayer.L2.getName()))
                        .put(NMSConstants.TOPOLOGY_PROTOCOLS, new JsonArray().add("CDP").add("LLDP"))
                        .put(SCHEDULER_SMS_RECIPIENTS, new JsonArray().add("7990311324")));

        TestAPIUtil.post(SCHEDULER_API_ENDPOINT, scheduler,
                testContext.succeeding(response ->
                        testContext.verify(() ->

                                TestUtil.vertx().setTimer(TimeUnit.SECONDS.toMillis(1), id ->
                                {
                                    TestAPIUtil.assertMultiCreateEntityTestResult(SchedulerConfigStore.getStore(), response.bodyAsJsonObject(), "Scheduler");

                                    // object references test case for topology schedulers
                                    TestAPIUtil.delete(OBJECT_API_ENDPOINT + "/" + objects.getLong(0),
                                            testContext.succeeding(httpResponse -> testContext.verify(() ->
                                                    {
                                                        assertEquals(SC_BAD_REQUEST, httpResponse.statusCode());

                                                        var body = httpResponse.bodyAsJsonObject();

                                                        Assertions.assertNotNull(body);

                                                        assertEquals(SC_BAD_REQUEST, body.getInteger(RESPONSE_CODE));

                                                        Assertions.assertNotNull(body.getJsonObject(RESULT));

                                                        body = body.getJsonObject(RESULT);

                                                        Assertions.assertTrue(body.containsKey(APIConstants.Entity.SCHEDULER.getName()));

                                                        Assertions.assertFalse(body.getJsonArray(APIConstants.Entity.SCHEDULER.getName()).isEmpty());

                                                        var object = ObjectConfigStore.getStore().getItemByValue(AIOpsObject.OBJECT_IP, "172.16.8.2");

                                                        Assertions.assertNotNull(object);

                                                        var metric = MetricConfigStore.getStore().getItemsByObject(object.getLong(ID)).stream()
                                                                .filter(item -> item.getString(Metric.METRIC_PLUGIN).equalsIgnoreCase(NMSConstants.MetricPlugin.SNMP_INTERFACE.getName())).map(JsonObject::copy)
                                                                .findFirst().orElse(null);

                                                        Assertions.assertNotNull(metric);

                                                        Assertions.assertTrue(metric.containsKey(Metric.METRIC_CONTEXT));

                                                        var discoveredObjects = metric.getJsonObject(Metric.METRIC_CONTEXT).getJsonArray(NMSConstants.DISCOVERED_OBJECTS);

                                                        var promise = Promise.<JsonArray>promise();

                                                        var probes = new JsonArray();

                                                        if (discoveredObjects == null || discoveredObjects.isEmpty())
                                                        {
                                                            var discoveries = DiscoveryConfigStore.getStore().getItemsByValue(Discovery.DISCOVERY_TARGET, "172.16.8.2");

                                                            Assertions.assertFalse(discoveries.isEmpty());

                                                            var futures = new ArrayList<Future<Void>>();

                                                            for (var index = 0; index < discoveries.size(); index++)
                                                            {
                                                                var future = Promise.<Void>promise();

                                                                futures.add(future.future());

                                                                Bootstrap.configDBService().getAll(DBConstants.TBL_DISCOVERY_RESULT + discoveries.getJsonObject(index).getLong(ID),
                                                                        result ->
                                                                        {
                                                                            if (result.succeeded() && !result.result().isEmpty())
                                                                            {
                                                                                probes.addAll(result.result());
                                                                            }

                                                                            future.complete();
                                                                        });
                                                            }

                                                            Future.join(futures).onComplete(result ->
                                                            {
                                                                if (!probes.isEmpty())
                                                                {
                                                                    var probe = probes.getJsonObject(0);

                                                                    var probeObjects = probe.getJsonArray(OBJECTS);

                                                                    Assertions.assertNotNull(probeObjects);

                                                                    Assertions.assertFalse(probeObjects.isEmpty());

                                                                    promise.complete(probeObjects);
                                                                }
                                                                else
                                                                {
                                                                    promise.fail(new Exception("failed to find discovery result"));
                                                                }
                                                            });
                                                        }
                                                        else
                                                        {
                                                            promise.complete(discoveredObjects);
                                                        }

                                                        promise.future().onComplete(result ->
                                                        {
                                                            if (result.succeeded())
                                                            {
                                                                var resultObjects = result.result();

                                                                Assertions.assertNotNull(resultObjects);

                                                                Assertions.assertFalse(resultObjects.isEmpty());

                                                                for (var index = 0; index < resultObjects.size(); index++)
                                                                {
                                                                    var discoveredObject = resultObjects.getJsonObject(index);

                                                                    discoveredObject.put(STATUS, STATUS_UP);
                                                                }

                                                                metric.getJsonObject(Metric.METRIC_CONTEXT).put(OBJECTS, resultObjects);

                                                                Bootstrap.configDBService().update(DBConstants.TBL_METRIC,
                                                                        new JsonObject().put(DBConstants.FIELD_NAME, ID).put(VALUE, metric.getLong(ID)),
                                                                        metric,
                                                                        DEFAULT_USER, SYSTEM_REMOTE_ADDRESS,
                                                                        asyncResponse ->
                                                                        {
                                                                            if (asyncResponse.failed())
                                                                            {
                                                                                testContext.failNow(asyncResponse.cause());
                                                                            }
                                                                            else
                                                                            {
                                                                                MetricConfigStore.getStore().updateItem(metric.getLong(ID)).onComplete(asyncResult ->
                                                                                {
                                                                                    if (asyncResult.failed())
                                                                                    {
                                                                                        testContext.failNow(asyncResult.cause());
                                                                                    }
                                                                                    else
                                                                                    {
                                                                                        var item = SchedulerConfigStore.getStore().getItem(response.bodyAsJsonObject().getJsonArray(ID).getLong(0));

                                                                                        Assertions.assertNotNull(item);

                                                                                        if (item.containsKey(SCHEDULER_CONTEXT))
                                                                                        {
                                                                                            item.mergeIn(item.getJsonObject(SCHEDULER_CONTEXT));

                                                                                            item.remove(SCHEDULER_CONTEXT);
                                                                                        }

                                                                                        item.getJsonArray(TopologyPlugin.TOPOLOGY_PLUGIN_ENTRY_POINTS).forEach(identity -> ObjectStatusCacheStore.getStore().updateItem(CommonUtil.getLong(identity), STATUS_UP, DateTimeUtil.currentSeconds()));

                                                                                        assertTestResult(testContext);

                                                                                        Bootstrap.vertx().eventBus().send(UI_ACTION_SCHEDULER_RUN, item.put(USER_NAME, DEFAULT_USER).put(SESSION_ID, TestUtil.getSessionId()));
                                                                                    }
                                                                                });
                                                                            }
                                                                        });
                                                            }
                                                            else
                                                            {
                                                                testContext.failNow(result.cause());
                                                            }
                                                        });
                                                    }
                                            )));
                                }))));

                            && eventContext.getString(AIOpsObject.OBJECT_IP).equalsIgnoreCase("172.16.8.2")

                            || eventContext.getJsonObject(EVENT_CONTEXT).getString(OBJECT).equalsIgnoreCase(NMSConstants.TopologyProtocol.LLDP.getName())))

    private void assertAssignObjectTestResult(VertxTestContext testContext, long id)
    {
        var retries = new AtomicInteger(0);

        TestUtil.vertx().setPeriodic(200, timer ->
        {
            retries.getAndIncrement();

            var size = USED_COUNTS.get(id);

            var item = TopologyPluginConfigStore.getStore().getItem(id);

            if (item == null)
            {
                TestUtil.vertx().cancelTimer(timer);

                testContext.failNow(new Exception("item not found"));
            }
            else
            {
                if (item.containsKey(TopologyPlugin.TOPOLOGY_PLUGIN_CONTEXT))
                {
                    item.mergeIn(item.getJsonObject(TopologyPlugin.TOPOLOGY_PLUGIN_CONTEXT));

                    item.remove(TopologyPlugin.TOPOLOGY_PLUGIN_CONTEXT);
                }

                Assertions.assertNotNull(item.getJsonArray(TopologyPlugin.TOPOLOGY_PLUGIN_ENTITIES));

                if (item.getJsonArray(TopologyPlugin.TOPOLOGY_PLUGIN_ENTITIES).size() == size)
                {
                    TestUtil.vertx().cancelTimer(timer);

                    testContext.completeNow();
                }

                if (retries.get() > 10)
                {
                    TestUtil.vertx().cancelTimer(timer);

                    testContext.failNow(new Exception("Topology plugin entities not match..."));
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private void prepareTestContext(JsonObject context)
    {
        var key = context.getString(TopologyPlugin.TOPOLOGY_PLUGIN_TYPE).equalsIgnoreCase(NMSConstants.TopologyPluginType.CUSTOM.getName()) ? PluginEngineConstants.SCRIPT : PluginEngineConstants.PARSING_SCRIPT;

        var item = context.getJsonObject(TopologyPlugin.TOPOLOGY_PLUGIN_CONTEXT);

        if (item != null && item.getString(key) != null && !item.getString(key).isEmpty())
        {
            var file = GlobalConstants.CURRENT_DIR + GlobalConstants.PATH_SEPARATOR + GlobalConstants.PLUGIN_SCRIPT_DIR + GlobalConstants.PATH_SEPARATOR + TOPOLOGY_DIR + GlobalConstants.PATH_SEPARATOR +
                    item.getString(key);

            if (Bootstrap.vertx().fileSystem().existsBlocking(file))
            {

					message := motadatatypes.MotadataString(consts.BlankString)

					for ; ; index++ {
						if splittedTokens[index].Contains("TimeCreated") {
							break
						}

						if index == 5 {
							message += getValue(splittedTokens[index])
						} else {
							message += " " + splittedTokens[index].TrimSpace().ReplaceAll("\t", " ")
						}
					}

					event["message"] = message

					event["timestamp"] = splittedTokens[index].SplitN(":", 2)[1].TrimSpace() //cannot be blank

					index++

					event["audit"] = getValue(splittedTokens[index]).ReplaceAll("{", "").ReplaceAll("}", "")

					index++

					event["task"] = getValue(splittedTokens[index])

					if timezone.IsNotEmpty() {
						event["timezone"] = timezone
					}

					_, err = socket.Write([]byte(fmt.Sprintf("%s%s", eventSource, event.ToJSON())))
				}

				result[consts.Status] = consts.StatusSucceed

			} else {
				errors = append(errors, motadatatypes.MotadataStringMap{
					consts.ErrorCode: consts.ErrorCodeNoItemFound,
					consts.Message:   "No log(s) found for specified time",
				})
			}
		}

		if len(client.GetErrors()) > 0 || len(errors) > 0 {
			errors = append(errors, client.GetErrors()...)
			result[consts.Errors] = errors
			result[consts.Status] = consts.StatusFail
		}
	}
}

func buildCommand(context motadatatypes.MotadataMap) motadatatypes.MotadataString {
	command := motadatatypes.MotadataString("[System.Threading.Thread]::CurrentThread.CurrentUICulture='en-US';[System.Threading.Thread]::CurrentThread.CurrentCulture='en-US';Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{")

	interval := 5

	maxEvents := 1000 //windows client is taking too much time is we don't declare any limit to it

	if context.Contains(consts.RunbookPluginVariables) && context.GetMapValue(consts.RunbookPluginVariables).IsNotEmpty() {
		variables := context.GetMapValue(consts.RunbookPluginVariables)

		if variables.Contains("log-name") {
			command += "logname="

			command += splitFields(variables.GetMotadataStringValue("log-name")) + ";"
		} else {
			command += "logname="

			command += "'System','Security','Application';"
		}

		if variables.Contains("event-id") {
			command += "id="

			command += splitFields(variables.GetMotadataStringValue("event-id")) + ";"
		}

		if variables.Contains("severity") {
			command += "level="

			command += motadatatypes.MotadataString(getSeverity(variables.GetStringValue("severity"))) + ";"
		}

		if variables.Contains("provider-name") {
			command += "providername="

			command += splitFields(variables.GetMotadataStringValue("provider-name")) + ";"
		}

		if variables.Contains("interval") {
			interval = variables.GetIntValue("interval")
		}
	} else {
		command += "logname="

		command += "'System','Security','Application';"
	}

	command += "starttime="

	duration := time.Now().Add(-time.Duration(interval) * time.Minute)

	command += "'" + motadatatypes.MotadataString(duration.Format("2006-01-02 15:04:05.000")) + "';"

	command += "} -MaxEvents " + motadatatypes.MotadataString(strconv.Itoa(maxEvents)) + " | format-list -property id,providername,level,leveldisplayname,logname,message,TimeCreated,keywordsDisplaynames,taskdisplayname"

	return command
}

func cleanUp(client *winrmclient.WinRMClient, result motadatatypes.MotadataMap, conn net.Conn) {
	if r := recover(); r != nil {
		result[consts.Errors] = []motadatatypes.MotadataStringMap{
			{
				consts.ErrorCode: consts.ErrorCodeInternalError,
				consts.Message:   "Invalid Result",
				consts.Error:     fmt.Sprintf("%v", r),
			},
		}
	}

	client.Destroy()

	err := conn.Close()

	if err != nil {
		result[consts.Errors] = []motadatatypes.MotadataStringMap{
			{
				consts.ErrorCode: consts.ErrorCodeInternalError,
				consts.Error:     err.Error(),
			},
		}
	}

func getSeverity(value string) string {
	severity := "0"

	switch value {
	case "LogAlways":
		severity = "0"
	case "Critical":
		severity = "1"
	case "Error":
		severity = "2"
	case "Warning":
		severity = "3"
	case "Informational":
		severity = "4"
	}

	return severity
}

func getValue(value motadatatypes.MotadataString) motadatatypes.MotadataString {
	if len(value.Split(":")) > 1 {
		return value.Split(":")[1].TrimSpace()
	}

	return consts.BlankString
}

func splitFields(token motadatatypes.MotadataString) motadatatypes.MotadataString {
	result := ""

	if token.Contains(",") {
		for _, value := range token.Split(",") {
			if value.IsNotEmpty() {
				result += "'" + string(value.TrimSpace()) + "'" + ","
			}
		}
		result = strings.TrimRight(result, ",")
	} else {
		result += "'" + string(token.TrimSpace()) + "'"
	}

	return motadatatypes.MotadataString(result)
}

func getTimeZone(client *winrmclient.WinRMClient) motadatatypes.MotadataString {
	timezone := client.ExecuteCommand("[Regex]::Replace([System.TimeZoneInfo]::Local.BaseUtcOffset, '(\\d+:\\d+)', '$1')")

	if timezone.IsNotEmpty() {
		if timezone.HasPrefix("-") {
			return timezone.TrimSpace()
		} else {
			return "+" + timezone.TrimSpace()
		}
	} else {
		return consts.BlankString
	}

/*
*   Runbook Variables
*
*   udp.port = 515                                                      --> Port to forward the logs
*   interval = 5 (unit: minutes)                                        --> Collect Logs which are 5 minutes earlier than the current time
 */
func run(result motadatatypes.MotadataMap, context motadatatypes.MotadataMap) {

	client := &vmwareclient.VMWareClient{}

	client.GetConnection(context)

	result[consts.Status] = consts.StatusFail

	var errors []motadatatypes.MotadataStringMap

	port := 515 // Default UDP log collector listener port

	eventSource := fmt.Sprintf("%-15s", context.GetStringValue(consts.ObjectIP)) // will append event source at starting from the message

	if context.Contains(consts.RunbookPluginVariables) {

		variable := context.GetMapValue(consts.RunbookPluginVariables)

		if variable.Contains("udp.port") {

			port = variable.GetIntValue("udp.port")
		}
	}

	socket, err := net.Dial("udp", "127.0.0.1:"+strconv.Itoa(port))

	if err != nil {

		errors = append(errors, motadatatypes.MotadataStringMap{

			consts.ErrorCode: consts.ErrorCodeConnectionFailed,
			consts.Message:   err.Error(),
		})

	} else {

		defer cleanUp(client, result, socket)

		ctx, cancel := contextlib.WithTimeout(contextlib.Background(), time.Second*time.Duration(context.GetIntValue(consts.Timeout)))

		defer cancel()

		if client.Init() {

			taskList, err := retrieveTasks(client, context, ctx)

			if err == nil && len(taskList) > 0 {

				for _, token := range taskList {

					event := make(motadatatypes.MotadataMap)

					event["vm.name"] = token.EntityName

					event["status"] = token.State

					event["complete.time"] = token.CompleteTime.String()

					event["start.time"] = token.StartTime.String()

					event["name"] = token.Name

					if strings.Contains(reflect.TypeOf(token.Reason).String(), "TaskReasonUser") {

						event["user.name"] = token.Reason.(*types.TaskReasonUser).UserName

					}

					if token.Description != nil {

						event["description"] = token.Description.Message

					} else {

						event["description"] = token.DescriptionId
					}

					// Parse the start and end times to calculate execution time
					startTime, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02 15:04:05.999999999 -0700 MST", event["start.time"].(string))

					// consider task start time as a timestamp and convert into seconds
					event["timestamp"] = startTime.Unix()

					if err != nil {
						loggerObj.Info("Failed to parse task start.time")
					}

					endTime, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02 15:04:05.999999999 -0700 MST", event["complete.time"].(string))

					if err != nil {
						loggerObj.Info("Failed to parse task complete.time")
					}

					event["execution.time.ms"] = endTime.Sub(startTime).Milliseconds()

					_, err = socket.Write([]byte(fmt.Sprintf("%s%s", eventSource, event.ToJSON())))

					if err != nil {

						loggerObj.Info(motadatatypes.MotadataString(fmt.Sprintf("Failed to send Log! %v", err.Error())))
					}

				}

				result[consts.Status] = consts.StatusSucceed

			}

			// in case of No log(s) found for specified time
			if len(taskList) == 0 && err == nil {

				loggerObj.Info("No log(s) found for specified time")

				result[consts.Status] = consts.StatusSucceed

			} else if err != nil {

				errors = append(errors, err...)
			}
		}

		if len(client.GetErrors()) > 0 || len(errors) > 0 {

			loggerObj.Info(motadatatypes.MotadataString(fmt.Sprintf("Errors : %v", errors)))

			errors = append(errors, client.GetErrors()...)

			result[consts.Errors] = errors

			result[consts.Status] = consts.StatusFail
		}
	}

}

func retrieveTasks(client *vmwareclient.VMWareClient, context motadatatypes.MotadataMap, ctx contextlib.Context) ([]types.TaskInfo, []motadatatypes.MotadataStringMap) {

	var errors []motadatatypes.MotadataStringMap

	taskManager := task.NewManager(client.GetClient().Client)

	interval := 5

	if context.Contains(consts.RunbookPluginVariables) && context.GetMapValue(consts.RunbookPluginVariables).IsNotEmpty() {

		variables := context.GetMapValue(consts.RunbookPluginVariables)

		if variables.Contains("interval") {

			interval = variables.GetIntValue("interval")
		}
	}

	startTime := time.Now().Add(-time.Duration(interval) * time.Minute)

	// Set up task filter specifications
	filter := types.TaskFilterSpec{Time: &types.TaskFilterSpecByTime{BeginTime: &startTime, TimeType: types.TaskFilterSpecTimeOption("startedTime")}}

	tasks, err := taskManager.CreateCollectorForTasks(ctx, filter)

	if err != nil {
		errors = append(errors, motadatatypes.MotadataStringMap{

			consts.ErrorCode: consts.ErrorCodeInternalError,
			consts.Message:   "Error while creating collector, Failed to retrieve tasks!",

func run(result MotadataMap, context MotadataMap) {

	result[consts.Status] = consts.StatusFail

	var errors []MotadataStringMap

	batchSize := 1000

	port := 515 // Default UDP log listener port

	eventSource := fmt.Sprintf("%-15s", context.GetStringValue(consts.ObjectIP))

	if context.Contains(consts.RunbookPluginVariables) {

		variables := context.GetMapValue(consts.RunbookPluginVariables)

		if variables.Contains("udp.port") {

			port = variables.GetIntValue("udp.port")
		}

		if variables.Contains("batch.size") {

			batchSize = variables.GetIntValue("batch.size")
		}
	}

	socket, err := net.Dial("udp", "127.0.0.1:"+strconv.Itoa(port))

	if err == nil {

		httpClient := &httpclient.HTTPClient{}

		defer cleanUp(httpClient, result, socket)

		httpClient.SetContext(context, &loggerObj)

		httpClient.SetURL(MotadataString(fmt.Sprintf(tokenURL, context.GetStringValue(consts.ObjectIP))))

		httpClient.SetBodyAsMap(MotadataMap{

			"aaaUser": MotadataMap{

				"attributes": MotadataMap{

					"name": context.GetStringValue(consts.UserName),
					"pwd":  context.GetStringValue(consts.Password),
				},
			},
		})

		response := httpClient.ExecutePOSTRequest()

		if response.GetMapValue(httpclient.URLResponseContent).IsNotEmpty() {

			if response.GetINTValue(httpclient.URLResponseCode) == httpclient.URLResponseCodeSuccess {

				output := response.GetMapValue(httpclient.URLResponseContent)

				cookieToken := ToMap(output.GetSliceValue("imdata")[0]).GetMapValue("aaaLogin").GetMapValue("attributes").GetStringValue("token")

				httpClient.SetHeaders(MotadataMap{

					"Cookie": "APIC-cookie=" + cookieToken,
				})

				httpClient.SetURL(MotadataString(fmt.Sprintf(faultRecordsURL, context.GetStringValue(consts.ObjectIP), 0, batchSize)))

				response = httpClient.ExecuteGETRequest()

				output = response.GetMapValue(httpclient.URLResponseContent)

				loggerObj.Info(MotadataString(fmt.Sprintf("Available Logs -> %s", output.GetStringValue("totalCount"))))

				for _, value := range output.GetSliceValue("imdata") {

					item := ToMap(value)

					item = item.GetMapValue("faultRecord").GetMapValue("attributes")

					if item.IsNotEmpty() {

						_, err = socket.Write([]byte(fmt.Sprintf("%s%s", eventSource, item.ToJSON())))
					}
				}

				collect := true

				for i := 1; collect; i++ {

					httpClient.SetURL(MotadataString(fmt.Sprintf(faultRecordsURL, context.GetStringValue(consts.ObjectIP), i, batchSize)))

					response = httpClient.ExecuteGETRequest()

					output = response.GetMapValue(httpclient.URLResponseContent)

					if len(output.GetSliceValue("imdata")) > 0 {

						loggerObj.Info(MotadataString(fmt.Sprintf("sending fault records.. page: %d", i)))

						for _, value := range output.GetSliceValue("imdata") {

							item := ToMap(value)

							item = item.GetMapValue("faultRecord").GetMapValue("attributes")

							if item.IsNotEmpty() {

								_, err = socket.Write([]byte(fmt.Sprintf("%s%s", eventSource, item.ToJSON())))
							}
						}

					} else {

						loggerObj.Info(MotadataString(fmt.Sprintf("No data found on page: %d", i)))

						collect = false

						result[consts.Status] = consts.StatusSucceed
					}
				}

			} else {

				loggerObj.Warn(MotadataString(fmt.Sprintf("Response code: %d", response.GetINTValue(httpclient.URLResponseCode))))

				errors = append(errors, MotadataStringMap{

					consts.Message:   fmt.Sprintf("Response code: %d", response.GetINTValue(httpclient.URLResponseCode)),
					consts.Error:     response.GetStringValue(consts.Error),
					consts.ErrorCode: consts.ErrorCodeInternalError,
				})
			}
		} else {

			loggerObj.Warn(MotadataString(fmt.Sprintf(consts.ErrorMessageNoResponse, httpClient.GetURL())))

			errors = append(errors, MotadataStringMap{

				consts.Message:   fmt.Sprintf(consts.ErrorMessageNoResponse, httpClient.GetURL()),
				consts.ErrorCode: consts.ErrorCodeNoResponse,
			})
		}

	} else {

		errors = append(errors, MotadataStringMap{

			consts.Message:   "failed to connect to server",
			consts.Error:     err.Error(),
			consts.ErrorCode: consts.ErrorCodeConnectionFailed,
		})

	}

	if len(errors) > 0 {

		context[consts.Errors] = errors
	}
}

In `APIServer.forgotPasswordLimitExceeded()`: Checks if a user has exceeded the forgot password request limit within the configured time window.

This method implements rate limiting for forgot password requests to prevent abuse and potential security attacks. It evaluates whether a user can make another forgot password request based on:

  • Number of previous attempts within the time window
  • Time elapsed since the last attempt
  • Configured maximum attempts and time window limits

Rate Limiting Logic:

  • If the time window has expired since the last attempt, the user can proceed
  • If within the time window and under the attempt limit, the user can proceed
  • If within the time window and at/over the attempt limit, the user is blocked

Security Benefits:

  • Prevents automated attacks on the password reset functionality
  • Reduces email spam from excessive reset requests
  • Protects against user enumeration attacks
@param user The user JsonObject containing forgot password attempt tracking data. Must include:
  • {@code USER_FORGOT_PASSWORD_ATTEMPTS} - Number of previous attempts (defaults to 0)
  • {@code USER_LAST_FORGOT_PASSWORD_ATTEMPT_TIME} - Timestamp of last attempt (defaults to 0)
@return {@code true} if the user is within limits and can make another request, {@code false} if the user has exceeded the limit and should be blocked

This method determines the maximum number of trace events that can be queued for processing by the trace datastore engine at any given time. The queue size affects memory usage and throughput of trace data processing.

The value is determined based on the configuration key "trace.datastore.engine.queue.size". If this key is present in the configuration, the method applies the following constraints:

  • Minimum value: 2,000 events
  • Maximum value: 50,000 events
If the configuration key is not present, a default value of 5,000 events is returned.

A larger queue size allows for handling higher volumes of trace data but requires more memory. In high-throughput environments, consider increasing this value while monitoring memory usage.

This class acts as a central coordinator for object management operations, handling events from various sources and updating the configuration database and cache stores accordingly.

    @RepeatedIfExceptionsTest(suspend = 3000L)
    @Order(7)
    void testSLOCycleSkipOldStartTimeAndStartForCurrentTime(VertxTestContext testContext)
    {
        try
        {
            items.clear();

            items.put(oldStartTimeSLOId, oldStartTimeSLO);

            var count = new AtomicInteger(0);

            var originalStartTime = oldStartTimeSLO.getLong(SLOProfile.SLO_PROFILE_START_TIME);

            // Invoke qualify method to trigger cycle start logic
            qualifyMethod.invoke(sloManager);

            TestUtil.vertx().setPeriodic(TimeUnit.SECONDS.toMillis(3), timer ->
            {
                if (sloCycles.containsKey(oldStartTimeSLOId))
                {
                    var cycleId = sloCycles.get(oldStartTimeSLOId);
                    var cycle = SLOCycleConfigStore.getStore().getItem(cycleId);

                    assertNotNull(cycleId, "New cycle should be created");
                    assertNotNull(cycle, "Cycle should exist in store");

                    var cycleStartTime = cycle.getLong(SLOCycle.SLO_CYCLE_START_TIME);
                    var cycleEndTime = cycle.getLong(SLOCycle.SLO_CYCLE_END_TIME);
                    var currentTime = DateTimeUtil.currentSeconds();

                    // Verify that the cycle start time is not the original old start time
                    assertNotEquals(originalStartTime, cycleStartTime,
                            "Cycle start time should not be the original old start time");

                    // Verify that the cycle start time is within reasonable range of current time
                    // For daily cycle, start time should be today's start time (within last 24 hours)
                    assertTrue(cycleStartTime >= currentTime - TimeUnit.DAYS.toSeconds(1),
                            "Cycle start time should be within the last 24 hours");

                    // Verify cycle duration is correct (24 hours for daily)
                    assertEquals(TimeUnit.DAYS.toSeconds(1), cycleEndTime - cycleStartTime,
                            "Cycle duration should be 24 hours for daily frequency");

                    // Verify SLO details are created
                    assertNotNull(sloDetails.get(oldStartTimeSLOId), "SLO details should be created");
                    assertNotNull(sloDetails.get(oldStartTimeSLOId).get(objectId.toString()),
                            "SLO details for object should be created");

                    // Verify profile is registered in sloProfilesByObject
                    assertNotNull(sloProfilesByObject.get(objectId), "Object should be registered");
                    assertNotNull(sloProfilesByObject.get(objectId).get(SLOConstants.SLOType.AVAILABILITY),
                            "Availability SLO type should be registered");
                    assertTrue(sloProfilesByObject.get(objectId).get(SLOConstants.SLOType.AVAILABILITY).contains(oldStartTimeSLOId),
                            "Old start time SLO profile should be registered for the object");

                    LOGGER.info(String.format("Test passed: Old start time %s was skipped, new cycle started at %s",
                            originalStartTime, cycleStartTime));

                    TestUtil.vertx().cancelTimer(timer);

                    testContext.completeNow();
                }
                else if (count.incrementAndGet() > 5)
                {
                    testContext.failNow("SLO cycle with old start time failed to start within expected time");

                    TestUtil.vertx().cancelTimer(timer);
                }
            });
        }
        catch (Exception exception)
        {
            testContext.failNow(exception);
        }
    }

In `LocalEventRouter.LocalEventRouter()`: The LocalEventRouter class routes events to appropriate handlers based on event type and routing key.

This class is responsible for:

  • Deploying multiple event router instances for load balancing
  • Routing events to the appropriate router based on a routing key
  • Supporting different routing strategies (dynamic, round-robin)
  • Managing the lifecycle of router instances (add/remove)
  • Handling event queries and bulk operations
  • Persisting router state for recovery after restart
  • Providing statistics about event processing when enabled

The LocalEventRouter supports multiple routing strategies:

  • Dynamic Routing: Time-based routing that routes to different handlers based on time. This is useful for cases like datastore-writer where data is written minute-wise, so events from the same minute are sent to the same datastore writer.
  • Round Robin Routing: Event-based routing that distributes events evenly across all available handlers. This is useful when multiple events arrive simultaneously and need to be processed in parallel.

The router maintains a mapping between routing keys and router instances, ensuring that events with the same routing key are consistently routed to the same handler. It also supports dynamic scaling by allowing router instances to be added or removed at runtime.

DNS Utility class that provides comprehensive DNS resolution services for the Motadata platform.

This class extends {@link AbstractVerticle} and serves as the central DNS management component, handling both forward and reverse DNS lookups, DNS cache management, and DNS server profile configuration. It automatically discovers system DNS servers and provides event-driven DNS resolution services.

Key Features:

  • Automatic discovery and configuration of system DNS servers
  • Forward DNS resolution (hostname to IP)
  • Reverse DNS resolution (IP to hostname)
  • DNS cache management and flushing
  • Multiple DNS server profile support with fallback mechanism
  • Event-driven architecture for asynchronous DNS operations
  • Integration with Motadata's object management system

DNS Server Priority:

DNS servers are prioritized with automatic (system-discovered) servers taking precedence over manually configured ones. The class implements a fallback mechanism where if one DNS server fails to resolve a query, it automatically tries the next available server.

The FlowCacheCleanupJob class is responsible for cleaning up outdated flow cache files in the Motadata platform.

This class implements the Quartz Job interface and performs regular cleanup of flow cache files to prevent excessive disk usage and maintain system performance. Flow cache files store network flow data temporarily and need to be periodically cleaned up to avoid accumulation of stale data.

The job performs the following tasks:

  1. Reads the flow-cache directory to list files
  2. Extracts timestamps from filenames (last 12 characters in yyyyMMddHHmm format)
  3. Deletes files older than 1 hour to ensure only recent data is kept
  4. Sends a cleanup event with the list of deleted files
  5. Sends a notification to clear cache from all event collectors

The job is scheduled to run every 6 hours to ensure regular cleanup of flow cache files.

Implementation note: This job was enhanced as part of MOTADATA-5435 to support the flow back-pressure mechanism.

  • Uses {@link #getItemsByGroups(JsonArray)} to find all objects belonging to those groups
  • If objects are found, creates/updates the user's entry in the map
  • If no objects are found and the user exists in the map, clears the user's set

Special handling:

  • Default User: The default user (ID = 1) has unrestricted access to all objects, regardless of group membership
  • Empty Groups: Users with no groups assigned will have an empty set or cleared entry

This method is typically called during:

  • System initialization to build the initial user-to-object mappings
  • User updates when user group assignments change
  • Bulk refresh operations to rebuild the entire map

                if (reply.succeeded())
                {
                    var response = (JsonObject) reply.result().body();

                }
            });
        }

The MotadataAppManager class is responsible for managing the lifecycle of the Motadata application.

This class serves as the central control system for the Motadata application, handling operations such as:

  • Starting, stopping, and restarting application components
  • Managing application upgrades and patches
  • Handling backup and restore operations
  • Coordinating communication between distributed components
  • Managing HTTP servers and event bus handlers
  • Monitoring system health and status

The MotadataAppManager extends Vert.x's AbstractVerticle to leverage the event-driven, non-blocking programming model for handling concurrent operations efficiently. It interacts with various system components through the event bus and maintains the overall state of the application.

This class implements a robust error handling mechanism and ensures proper coordination between different components during critical operations like upgrades and restarts.

Architecture and Design

The MotadataAppManager follows a reactive, event-driven architecture:

  • Event Processing: The class processes events received through the Vert.x event bus, dispatching them to appropriate handler methods based on event type.
  • Asynchronous Operations: All operations are performed asynchronously using Vert.x's Future/Promise pattern to ensure non-blocking behavior.
  • Component Management: The class manages the lifecycle of child processes and components, ensuring they are started, stopped, and monitored appropriately.
  • HTTP Server: The class sets up and manages an HTTP server for handling web-based operations and API endpoints.

Event Handling

The MotadataAppManager handles various types of events:

  • Lifecycle Events: Start, stop, restart events for application components
  • State Change Events: Enable, disable events for components
  • Upgrade Events: Events for upgrading application components or the manager itself
  • Backup/Restore Events: Events for backing up and restoring system data
  • Heartbeat Events: Events for monitoring system health
  • Switchover Events: Events for high availability operations

File Operations

The class performs various file operations for backup, restore, and upgrade:

  • Copying and transferring files between directories
  • Extracting and processing ZIP archives
  • Reading and writing configuration files
  • Managing system files and directories

Process Management

The MotadataAppManager manages external processes:

  • Starting and stopping child processes
  • Monitoring process health and status
  • Handling process output and errors
  • Managing process IDs and registration

Error Handling

The class implements comprehensive error handling:

  • All operations return Futures that can be composed and chained
  • Exceptions are caught, logged, and propagated appropriately
  • Error messages are standardized and include error codes
  • Recovery mechanisms are implemented for critical operations

Usage

The MotadataAppManager is typically used by:

  • System bootstrap processes to initialize the application
  • Administrative interfaces to control application lifecycle
  • Monitoring systems to track application health
  • Upgrade and maintenance processes to perform system updates

    /**
     * Qualifies an event against applicable policies.
     * This method:
     * 1. Determines the event type (log, flow, trap)
     * 2. Finds applicable policies based on event source and groups
     * 3. Evaluates the event against policy conditions
     * 4. Forwards qualified events to the EventPolicyInspector
     *
     * @param event The event to qualify, containing event data and metadata
     */
    private void qualify(JsonObject event)
    {
        try
        {
            var item = EventSourceConfigStore.getStore().getItemByHost(event.getString(EVENT_SOURCE), false);

            if (item != null)
            {
                for (var entry : assign(item.getJsonArray(LogEngineConstants.SOURCE_GROUPS), event.getString(EVENT_SOURCE), event.getString(LogEngineConstants.EVENT_SOURCE_TYPE)).entrySet())
                {
                    for (var value : entry.getValue())
                    {
                        var policy = policies.get(value);

                        if (policy.getString(POLICY_STATE).equalsIgnoreCase(YES) && !suppressedPolicies.contains(value))
                        {
                            var context = policy.getJsonObject(POLICY_CONTEXT);

                            if (event.containsKey(entry.getKey()) && event.getValue(entry.getKey()) != null)
                            {
                                var valid = !numericColumns.contains(entry.getKey()) || CommonUtil.getLong(event.getValue(entry.getKey())) > 0;

                                if (valid && context.containsKey(POLICY_RESULT_BY) && !context.getJsonArray(POLICY_RESULT_BY).isEmpty())
                                {
                                    for (var i = 0; i < context.getJsonArray(POLICY_RESULT_BY).size(); i++)
                                    {
                                        var counter = context.getJsonArray(POLICY_RESULT_BY).getString(i);

                                        if (!event.containsKey(counter) && !CommonUtil.isNotNullOrEmpty(CommonUtil.getString(event.getValue(counter))))
                                        {
                                            valid = false;
                                        }
                                    }
                                }

                                if (valid)
                                {
                                    var filter = context.getJsonObject(FILTERS).getJsonObject(DATA_FILTER, null);

                                    var groupConditionSatisfied = true;

                                    if (filter != null && !filter.isEmpty())
                                    {
                                        var groupOperator = filter.getString(OPERATOR);

                                        var conditionGroups = filter.getJsonArray(CONDITION_GROUPS);

                                        for (var index = 0; index < conditionGroups.size(); index++)
                                        {
                                            var conditionGroup = conditionGroups.getJsonObject(index);

                                            var operator = conditionGroup.getString(OPERATOR);

                                            var conditions = conditionGroup.getJsonArray(CONDITIONS);

                                            var satisfied = false;

                                            for (var j = 0; j < conditions.size(); j++)
                                            {
                                                var condition = conditions.getJsonObject(j);

                                                var operand = condition.getString(OPERAND).contains(CARET_SEPARATOR) ? condition.getString(OPERAND).split(CARET_SEPARATOR_WITH_ESCAPE)[0] : condition.getString(OPERAND);

                                                if (event.containsKey(operand))
                                                {
                                                    satisfied = PolicyEngineConstants.evaluateCondition(conditionGroup.getString(FILTER).equalsIgnoreCase("include"), condition.getString(OPERATOR), condition.getValue(VALUE), event.getValue(operand));

                                                    if ((satisfied && operator.equalsIgnoreCase(DatastoreConstants.ConditionGroup.OR.getName())) || (!satisfied && operator.equalsIgnoreCase(DatastoreConstants.ConditionGroup.AND.getName())))
                                                    {
                                                        break;
                                                    }
                                                }
                                            }

                                            if (!satisfied && groupOperator.equalsIgnoreCase(DatastoreConstants.ConditionGroup.AND.getName()))
                                            {
                                                //if main condition is "AND" and any counter group condition is not true so breaking for loop as in "AND" condition all condition is needed to be true
                                                groupConditionSatisfied = false;

                                                break;
                                            }
                                            else if (satisfied && groupOperator.equalsIgnoreCase(DatastoreConstants.ConditionGroup.OR.getName()))
                                            {
                                                //if main condition is "OR" and any counter group condition is true so breaking for loop as in "OR" condition only one condition needed to be true
                                                groupConditionSatisfied = true;

                                                break;
                                            }
                                            else if (!satisfied && groupOperator.equalsIgnoreCase(DatastoreConstants.ConditionGroup.OR.getName()))
                                            {
                                                groupConditionSatisfied = false;
                                            }
                                        }

                                        if (groupConditionSatisfied)
                                        {
                                            var result = new JsonObject();

                                            //will forward required fields only to inspector
                                            for (var key : filters.get(policy.getLong(ID)))
                                            {
                                                result.put(CommonUtil.getString(key), event.getString(CommonUtil.getString(key)));
                                            }

                                            aggregate(result.put(POLICY_ID, value).put(EVENT_TIMESTAMP, event.getLong(EVENT_TIMESTAMP)).put(EVENT_COPY_REQUIRED, false));

                                            if (MotadataConfigUtil.devMode())
                                            {
                                                vertx.eventBus().publish(EventBusConstants.EVENT_EVENT_POLICY_TEST, new JsonObject().put(POLICY_ID, value).put(EVENT_TIMESTAMP, event.getLong(EVENT_TIMESTAMP)).put(EVENT_COPY_REQUIRED, false));
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                    else
                                    {
                                        var result = new JsonObject();

                                        //will forward required fields only to inspector
                                        for (var key : filters.get(policy.getLong(ID)))
                                        {
                                            result.put(CommonUtil.getString(key), event.getString(CommonUtil.getString(key)));
                                        }

                                        aggregate(result.put(POLICY_ID, value).put(EVENT_TIMESTAMP, event.getLong(EVENT_TIMESTAMP)).put(EVENT_COPY_REQUIRED, false));

                                        if (MotadataConfigUtil.devMode())
                                        {
                                            vertx.eventBus().publish(EventBusConstants.EVENT_EVENT_POLICY_TEST, new JsonObject().put(POLICY_ID, value).put(EVENT_TIMESTAMP, event.getLong(EVENT_TIMESTAMP)).put(EVENT_COPY_REQUIRED, false));
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        catch (Exception exception)
        {
            LOGGER.error(exception);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Finds applicable policies for an event based on its source, source type, and groups.
     * This method aggregates policies from different mapping sources to create a complete
     * set of policies that should be evaluated for the event.
     *
     * @param groups          The groups associated with the event source
     * @param source          The event source
     * @param eventSourceType The event source type
     * @return A map of data points to sets of policy IDs that should be evaluated
     */
    private Map<String, Set<Long>> assign(JsonArray groups, String source, String eventSourceType)
    {
        var qualifiedPolicies = new HashMap<String, Set<Long>>();

        try
        {
            policiesBySource.getOrDefault(source, Collections.emptyMap()).forEach((key, policyIds) ->
            {
                if (!policyIds.isEmpty())
                {
                    qualifiedPolicies.computeIfAbsent(key, value -> new LinkedHashSet<>()).addAll(policyIds);
                }
            });


            if (CommonUtil.isNotNullOrEmpty(eventSourceType))
            {
                policiesBySourceType.getOrDefault(eventSourceType, Collections.emptyMap()).forEach((key, policyIds) ->
                {
                    if (!policyIds.isEmpty())
                    {
                        qualifiedPolicies.computeIfAbsent(key, value -> new LinkedHashSet<>()).addAll(policyIds);
                    }
                });
            }

            for (var index = 0; index < groups.size(); index++)
            {
                var group = groups.getLong(index);

                policiesByGroup.getOrDefault(group, Collections.emptyMap()).forEach((key, policyIds) ->
                {
                    if (!policyIds.isEmpty())
                    {
                        qualifiedPolicies.computeIfAbsent(key, value -> new LinkedHashSet<>()).addAll(policyIds);
                    }
                });
            }
        }
        catch (Exception exception)
        {
            LOGGER.error(exception);
        }

        return qualifiedPolicies;
    }

    /**
     * Maps policies to event sources, source types, and groups.
     * This method builds the mapping between policies and the entities they apply to,
     * which is essential for efficient policy qualification.
     */
    private void qualify()
    {
        policiesBySource.clear();

        policiesByGroup.clear();

        policiesBySourceType.clear();

        try
        {
            policies.forEach((key, value) ->
            {
                var policyContext = value.getJsonObject(POLICY_CONTEXT);

                var dataPoint = policyContext.getString(VisualizationConstants.DATA_POINT);

                JsonArray entities;

                if (policyContext.getJsonArray(ENTITIES) != null && !policyContext.getJsonArray(ENTITIES).isEmpty())//if policy contains filter of group or monitor so just assigning that filtered entities or groups
                {
                    entities = policyContext.getJsonArray(ENTITIES);

                    if (policyContext.getString(ENTITY_TYPE).equalsIgnoreCase(APIConstants.Entity.GROUP.getName()))
                    {
                        assignById(value.getLong(ID), dataPoint, entities, policiesByGroup);
                    }
                    else if (policyContext.getString(ENTITY_TYPE).equalsIgnoreCase(VisualizationConstants.VisualizationGrouping.EVENT_SOURCE_TYPE.getName()))
                    {
                        assignBySource(value.getLong(ID), dataPoint, entities, policiesBySourceType);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        assignBySource(value.getLong(ID), dataPoint, entities, policiesBySource);
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    if (dataPoint.equalsIgnoreCase(MESSAGE) || dataPoint.equalsIgnoreCase(LogEngineConstants.EVENT_CATEGORY) || dataPoint.equalsIgnoreCase(LogEngineConstants.EVENT_SOURCE_TYPE) || dataPoint.equalsIgnoreCase(EVENT_SOURCE))
                    {
                        entities = EventSourceConfigStore.getStore().flatItems(EVENT_SOURCE);
                    }
                    else if (!eventColumns.isEmpty() && eventColumns.containsKey(dataPoint))
                    {
                        entities = EventSourceConfigStore.getStore().flatItemsByMultiValueFields(EVENT_TYPE, value.getString(POLICY_TYPE).toLowerCase(), EVENT_SOURCE, PLUGIN_ID, eventColumns.getJsonObject(dataPoint).getJsonArray(DatastoreConstants.MAPPER_PLUGIN_IDS));
                    }
                    else entities = new JsonArray();

                    assignBySource(value.getLong(ID), dataPoint, entities, policiesBySource);
                }
            });
        }
        catch (Exception exception)
        {
            LOGGER.error(exception);
        }

    }

    {
        try

                var object = CommonUtil.getString(entity);

                if (!policiesByEntity.containsKey(object))

                    policiesByEntity.get(object).put(key, new ArrayList<>());

                else if (!policiesByEntity.get(object).containsKey(key))

                if (!policiesByEntity.get(object).get(key).contains(policyId))

                    policiesByEntity.get(object).get(key).add(policyId);
                }
            });
        }

        catch (Exception exception)
        {
            LOGGER.error(exception);
        }
    }
